        visualRuns
      • visualRuns(text: string; base: BaseDirection): VisualText

Bidirectional algorithm (UAX #9) over code points.

Implements paragraph level (P2-P3), explicit embeddings and isolates (X1-X8 with overflow counters), weak resolution (W1-W7), bracket pairs and neutrals (N0-N2), implicit levels (I1-I2), visual reordering (L2), and mirroring (L4) for one pre-split paragraph. Line splitting (L1) stays the caller's problem, except trailing whitespace and isolate codes collapse to the paragraph level. Runs never start with a combining mark (see visualRuns).

Procs

proc visualRuns(text: string; base: BaseDirection): VisualText {....raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Shapes one pre-split paragraph into visual runs in display order. Callers split paragraphs and lines first; B and S handling past the trailing L1 reset is out of scope. X9-removed codes never reach the output, and odd-level runs carry L4 mirrors, so text is shaping-ready while map keeps every byte traceable to its logical source offset. Runs group maximal levels; attachables (marks, ZWJ, variation selectors) starting a run merge into the previous run only when no base follows them in that run, so marks stay positioned on their bases. A paragraph-initial attachable run stands alone. Each run shapes with an explicit direction, bypassing segment guessing.
